text:
priya: heads-up: recurring problem where design partner asks grow during engineering work. can we make a fast-track + slow-path so scopes are clearer upfront?
sam: yes. my suggestion: fast-track = low-risk config/ux tweaks, slow-path = new infra, data access, or SLA requests.
cleo: we should codify "risk" into a 0-10 score. examples: data sensitivity, infra changes, customer priority.
mike: +1. also add explicit outputs per path: fast-track -> 2-week EM-owned deliverable, slow-path -> spec + design + cost estimate.
priya: propose form fields: requested change (short), expected user impact, data exposure (none/low/high), infra change (yes/no), desired timeline. keep it short.
sam: can we add a checkbox: "willing to join 2 feedback sessions"? if no, deprioritize.
cleo: love that. also require a small sample prompt set for quality checks. without prompts it's impossible to evaluate regressions.
ops-bot: FYI: any request with "on-prem" or "private deployment" will be auto-tagged for security + legal.
mike: scoring idea (pseudo):
```
score = 0
if data_exposure == 'high': score += 4
if infra_change == 'yes': score += 3
if customer_priority == 'enterprise': score += 2
# 0-2 -> fast-track, 3-6 -> review, 7+ -> slow-path (spec + pilot)
```
priya: once scored: fast-track gets an owner and a 5-business-day SLA for go/no-go. review path gets a 10-day spec. slow-path needs PD+Eng design review.
sam: add rollback & test plan requirement for anything touching model weights, prompts, or ingestion. even for fast-track, if it touches prompts require smoke test.
cleo: for launch criteria (beta): 3 sample customers, demo runbook, monitoring: prompt-level sampling + latency p95, token cost estimate. quality threshold: >=75% human pass on core prompts.
mike: operational checklist for PD: owner assigned, cost estimate, security sign-off if data_exposure != none, automated smoke, sample prompts linked.
priya: i'll draft a one-pager and a compact intake form (Google form -> webhook) that runs an initial scoring lambda. can have MVP in 10 business days?
ops-bot: reminder set: follow-up in 7 days to check intake form progress.
sam: i'll pair with priya on lambda. cleo will write the quality threshold table. mike will sketch the rollout SLA language.
priya: after MVP we should run the fast-track on 3 internal experiments then invite 2 real design partners. goal: cut unexpected scope change by 50%.
cleo: can someone make a short outreach template for DP invite that includes the prompt-sharing checkbox? saves back-and-forth.
mike: i'll do that and add an NDA line option.
priya: great. thanks team — will post the draft runbook here when ready.
